description: Ministry of Defence - Award of the Sri Lanka Armed Services Long Service Medal
categorisation: This gazette announces the award of the Sri Lanka Armed Services Long Service Medal to military personnel (both officers and enlisted members) for completing 12 years of service. This falls under public service administration as it deals with service recognition, awards, and benefits for members of the armed forces, which is a public sector service matter. While it mentions the President's approval, it does not involve government structural changes, personnel appointments with detailed portfolios, or fit any other specialized category better than Public Service.
